# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest release versions of our platform images and addons are actively updated and supported. If you encounter a security vulnerability in older versions, please update to the latest release tag.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| Latest  | :white_check_mark: |
| < Last  | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We request that you do not open public GitHub issues for security vulnerabilities. Instead, please report security concerns responsibly:

1. Send an email to the maintainer at `me@szabee.me`.
2. Include details of the vulnerability, steps to reproduce, and any potential remediation/hotfix suggestions.
3. We will acknowledge receipt of the report within 48 hours and work with you on a resolution plan and coordinated disclosure.
